name: DaYan ZhanChi V5 M 3x3 (Standard)
description: The ZhanChi V5 M 3x3 is a new flagship 3x3 from DaYan. This cube has everything you would ever want in a customizable 3x3. It has adjustable tension, compression, and magnet strength. It comes in three different versions with varying degrees of magnetic attraction and repulsion. This is the Standard version with white internals, conical spring tensioning system, and edge/corner - corner/core magnetization.
